physics_domain_unset.description: physics_domain is set on the live name

physics_domain_not_derived.description: physics_domain equals select_primary_domain(expected), the derivation's answer for the name's expected source set
physics_domain_not_derived.comparison_fidelity: approximate — the census splits this disagreement over three rows

source_domains_not_expected.description: source_domains equals the expected set — the name's current DD sources' domains, or its live children's union for a derived parent
source_domains_not_expected.comparison_fidelity: near-exact — the census set is the name's DD sources' domains

edges_not_source_domains.description: HAS_PHYSICS_DOMAIN edges are exactly source_domains, and every edge names the domain it points at
